test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Imaculate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'immaculate'.
 
• Immaculate: perfectly clean, neat, or tidy.

Therefore, the correct answer is option **(1) Imaculate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Other Options and their meanings-

 
• Immense- Very big or great
 
• Impediment- Something that makes it difficult for a person or thing to move or progress
 
• Immature- Not fully grown or developed
